jsonld_raw.name: GRACEFULLY ME EDP 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ)
jsonld_raw.description:
GRACEFULLY ME EDP 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ). A collection that celebrates the beauty of lived experiences. A tribute to the woman who has learned to embrace every chapter of her history and finds her greatest expression of elegance in her own journey.

The vitality of pink pepper gives way to the femininity of tuberose, while vanilla envelops the composition with a soft and addictive warmth. A floral gourmand that reveals a confident, serene, and character-filled femininity.

Floral gourmand | Luminous, enveloping, and sophisticated
